title: helm: refactor redwood-private values schema and init hooks for upgrade/rollback
author: Sophie Tran
description:
Motivation: stabilize Helm upgrades and rollbacks for Redwood Private deployments by making values.yaml schema stricter, improving templating for init jobs, and adding hook ordering/timeout guarantees. The current chart has several hard-to-debug upgrade failures when CRDs and init-hooks interact under high cluster load; this PR addresses those by tightening the values schema, making templates idempotent, and introducing pre-upgrade/post-rollback helper hooks.

What changed (high level):
- Add JSON Schema for values (values.schema.json) covering new keys: initJobs, hooks.timeoutSeconds, hooks.order, pvcRetentionPolicy, crdUpgradeStrategy.
- Refactor init job templating to be idempotent and to expose backoffLimit/retry settings via values.
- Add explicit helm hooks for pre-upgrade and post-rollback to run CRD migration/cleanup jobs with configurable timeouts and ordering.
- Update _helpers.tpl to centralize hook annotation generation and consistent naming for hook jobs.
- Bump Chart.yaml version to 3.5.0 and document upgrade notes in charts/redwood-private/README.md.

Backward compatibility: Defaults preserve existing behavior for most customers. The schema adds validation warnings for deprecated fields and automatically maps legacy fields where possible (see migration_notes in README). Chart will fail Helm 3 strict installs if values violate the schema; we added guidance on how to opt-out during a rolling migration.

Testing:
- Unit: helm lint and schema validation added to CI.
- Integration: ran upgrade/rollback matrix on KinD and on our internal QA cluster with 3 upgrade/rollback cycles against a mixed-version deployment; observed no leftover init-jobs or orphaned PVCs.
- Manual: exercised failure paths (timeout, API server flakiness) and verified rollback hooks run and revert CRD-compatible changes.

Release notes: see release_notes field. Migration: follow documented steps in README; recommend enabling schema validation in staging first.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add schema and defaults
- [x] Make init job templates idempotent
- [x] Add pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks with ordering
- [x] Update docs and README
- [x] Add CI checks
commits: 1) add values.schema.json and schema validation logic; 2) refactor templates/init-jobs.yaml to be idempotent and plumb retry/timeouts from values; 3) add templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-migrate.yaml and templates/hooks/post-rollback-cleanup.yaml; 4) update _helpers.tpl and Chart.yaml version bump; 5) update README with migration notes and examples
